scope: Mechanical geometry corrections and wheel-hub keys; not a complete procurement/manufacturing release.
procurement_status: No orders placed. Russian seller stock, grade certificates and delivery are not confirmed by this revision.
correction: R14 assembly PASS was rejected by an independent audit. Retained component selections do not imply that R14 geometry passed.

updates.note: Six keys and both mating keyways are now actual named/cut solids. CAD clearances are not released manufacturing tolerances. Ganter catalog lists the exact size in packs of10.
R14's two disconnected cylinders replaced by a connected shank,90deg cone and rim; matching clearance bores and countersinks cut. Threads are bounded masks, not modeled flanks.
R14 diameter13 cylinder understated corner envelope. R15 uses the full hexagon.
Both support bores rebuilt at their own bearing coordinates; entire bracket is no longer translated.

updates.part: Machined body with side sealing flanges
updates.note: The6.5mm flange replaces R14's incorrect13mm addition. Full4mm bridge support lands restored.
Rounded rectangle retains all corner bolt lands; internal bearing bosses and nominal seal grooves included.
The previous0.5mm unsupported gap is removed; face contact does not certify heat flow or clamping.

unchanged_architecture.side_gears: 5x Z50 m1 per side, tooth/retention design still open
unchanged_architecture.main_tether: existing reinforced six-core copper Proteus tether;40m first demo
